Dr. Sanduk Ruit was most likely conferred the National Order of Merit of Bhutan in Gold on 17 December 2015, which is Bhutan's National Day. This revises my earlier answer of 2018. I'm going from memory, not a checked source, and the team note's reasoning about National Day is only a hint. I'm fairly confident about the day and month, but less sure of the year.

CONFIDENCE: 60
